prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person refueling a car at dusk. The subject is seen from the shoulders down, wearing a thick, dark navy blue cardigan with bold white patterns of birds and abstract shapes, the texture of the knit clearly visible. The person’s hand, in sharp focus, grips a green gas pump nozzle, poised to insert it into the open fuel tank of a blue vehicle, which is partially visible on the right edge of the frame. The lighting is soft and moody, with a warm, golden glow from the setting sun contrasting against the cool blue tones of the evening sky in the background. The overall color palette is rich and saturated, emphasizing deep blues, greens, and creamy whites. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, blurring the background and drawing attention to the hand, the gas pump, and the intricate details of the sweater. The image has a filmic quality, evoking a sense of quiet, everyday ritual with a touch of nostalgia and intimacy.
